stem:
The diagram shows an object in front of a plane mirror and the image the mirror forms.

Which set of properties of the image is correct?

options.text: The image is upright, the same size as the object, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, smaller than the object, appears behind the mirror, and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, the same size as the object, appears behind the mirror, and can be obtained on a screen.
Every mirror forms an upright image the same size as the object.

teacher.key_rationale: A plane-mirror image is upright, same size as the object, behind the mirror, and virtual so it cannot be caught on a screen. Treating it as smaller, as screen-catchable, or as true of every mirror is wrong.
teacher.figure_note: Plane mirror with object and equal-distance virtual image.
